Did Angerfist evolve as an artist

Author

Max Bonnet 

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
df <- read.csv("music-analysis.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

Background

  • Founding Father

  • Old DJ

  • Hardstyle

  • Raise your fist

Did this guy actually change his style?

Limits

  • No albums

  • Little years of data

  • No data on the producing process and specifically highs, mids and lows

Analysis

ggplot(df, aes(x = Year, y = Energy)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Average Energy Over Time",
       x = "Release Year",
       y = "Energy")

Can we find this somewhere else too?

ggplot(df, aes(x = Year, y = Tempo)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Tempo Evolution",
       x = "Release Year",
       y = "Tempo (BPM)")
ggplot(df, aes(x = Year, y = Loudness)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Loudness Over Time",
       x = "Release Year",
       y = "Loudness (dB)")
df_yearly <- df |> 
  group_by(Year) |> 
  summarise(
    Energy = mean(Energy, na.rm = TRUE),
    Tempo = mean(Tempo, na.rm = TRUE),
    Loudness = mean(Loudness, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

df_scaled <- df_yearly |> 
  mutate(
    Energy = scale(Energy)[,1],
    Tempo = scale(Tempo)[,1],
    Loudness = scale(Loudness)[,1]
  ) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Year,
    names_to = "feature",
    values_to = "value"
  )

ggplot(df_scaled, aes(x = Year, y = value, color = feature)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linetype = "dashed", size = 1.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Evolution of Angerfist's Musical Style with Linear Trends",
    x = "Release Year",
    y = "Standardized Feature Value (Z-score)",
    color = "Audio Feature"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
